div.div: مَطَرَةٌ , (Fr, Sgh, K, also mentioned in the L, on the authority of IAar, and in such a manner as implies that it may be also ↓ مَطْرَةٌ , TA,) A [skin of the kind called] قِرْبَة: (K, &c.:) applied in the present day to an إِدَاوَة and the like: (TA:) [I have found it now applied to a large bottle of leather, and of wood: pl. أَمْطَارٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
